card.name: Linking words before a named item
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, with, the, and, or a colon, right before a specific name is expected (an element, a state, a drug). Also fires on some drug-name endings in lists.

modes.label: Link word before a name
modes.description: A word like of, with or a colon that leads into a specific named thing such as an element, state or drug.
modes.example: Twenty-six isotopes<< of>> cobalt ranging from Co-50

modes.label: Place-name lead-in
modes.description: The word of or a colon introducing a state name.
modes.example: is a county in the U.S. state<< of>> California.

modes.label: Inside drug names in lists
modes.description: Last piece of a drug name in an interaction list.

card.writes: No clear theme; it mildly promotes assorted name pieces from many languages and suppresses other unrelated words.
card.plain: It marks little connecting words that come just before a specific name, like a state or a drug.
